recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it completes FHIR-22649 in current core source without adding redundant prose or reopening the separate datatype precision/range issue.
issue_request: FHIR-22649 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core safety change request asking for a safety page note about JSON decimal precision that points to the JSON primitive dragon section, and for that JSON note to reference the explicit quantity precision extension.
initial_application: Git commit 319c9305544fe9cfc6e34a59742f10e5846d4f2e added the visible safety checklist line and a JSON precision-extension link. Commit b3e373388f8137e589fdc6b18beb9ff86a2c23cb later updated the JSON link to the current [%extensions-location%]StructureDefinition-quantity-precision.html form. The current source already had the safety note and JSON dragon reference, but the decimal checklist item reused the use-provenance anchor and the active safety-entries CodeSystem did not include a matching decimal concept.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread records the motivating safety concern that common JSON parsers can lose trailing-zero decimal precision, explicitly says the warning belongs on the safety page, files GF#22649, and points to extension-quantity-precision. source/hierarchy.xml lists safety.html as Clinical Safety, and source/fhir.ini actively includes codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml. FHIR-22655 came from the same discussion but is a separate decimal datatype range/precision issue and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Changed source/safety.html so the decimal checklist item anchors as decimal instead of duplicating use-provenance, and added the corresponding decimal concept to source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml. No JSON source edit was needed because the current dragon note already points to the quantity-precision extension through the current extension-pack location mechanism.
source_changes: source/safety.html: corrected the decimal safety checklist anchor from use-provenance to decimal.
source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml: added the decimal checklist concept with the same JSON decimal precision guidance.
